definitions.gloss: suppuration; festering; becoming infected with pus
definitions.explanation: The formation of pus in a wound or infected area. A medical term used in both clinical and everyday contexts when a wound becomes infected.

examples.japanese: ⟦{傷|きず}→傷：02201_kizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{化膿|かのう}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまった。
{化膿|かのう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{消毒|しょうどく}した→消毒する：17818_shoudokusuru⟧。
examples.english: I disinfected it to prevent infection.

examples.japanese: ⟦{傷口|きずぐち}→傷口：09517_kizuguchi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{化膿|かのう}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{赤|あか}く→赤い：00585_akai⟧⟦{腫|は}れて→腫れる：12325_hareru⟧きた⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ことにした。
examples.english: The wound festered and became red and swollen, so I decided to go to the hospital.

notes:
USAGE:
{化膿|かのう} is used both as a medical term and in everyday conversation when describing infected wounds. It is commonly used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ to form a verb.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{傷|きず}→傷：02201_kizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{化膿|かのう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (a wound festers)
- {化膿|かのう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧ (to prevent infection)
- {化膿|かのう}{止|ど}め (antiseptic — prevents suppuration)
- {化膿|かのう}{性|せい} (purulent, suppurative)

MEDICAL CONTEXT:
A doctor might say {化膿|かのう}⟦しています→する：00392_suru⟧ (it's infected) when examining a wound. Over-the-counter {化膿|かのう}{止|ど}め (antiseptic) products are commonly available at pharmacies.
